_about: A model of the GRANT SELECT statements on the HR warehouse. grants maps each role to the tables it may SELECT from and the columns it gets: ["*"] for every column, a list of names for column-level security, or no entry for no access to that table.

needs.Analysts: Headcount and tenure reports from Employees. Must never see Salary, BankAccount or anything in SalaryHistory.
needs.PayrollApp: Only EmployeeID, Salary and BankAccount from Employees. Nothing else.
